passages.title: The Leaning Shelves
passages.text: In the village of Karanpur, the library was a single room above the post office. It had no air conditioner, only a rattling ceiling fan, and the shelves leaned like tired old men. Yet every evening, children crowded in, sitting cross-legged on the floor with a book in every lap. The librarian, Mr. Verma, never raised his voice. He believed that a library should feel like a field after rain: quiet, but full of growing things. When the government proposed shifting the books to a modern building ten kilometres away, the villagers protested politely but firmly. 'A book is borrowed with the feet before it is borrowed with the hands,' said an old farmer. 'Take the shelves far from us and you take the books from us.' The proposal was quietly withdrawn, and the leaning shelves stayed exactly where they were.

passages.title: The Lamp in the Window
passages.text:
Each evening, when the market sounds grow thin,
And dusk spreads slowly like a dark blue sea,
My mother lights a small lamp, and within
Its trembling flame the whole world waits for me.

The road is long; the wind is sharp and wild;
The stars are hidden by a veil of rain.
Yet like a mother's arms around a child,
That little light calls gently through the pain.

I have seen cities built of glass and steel,
Where lamps by thousands blaze above the street,
But none of them can make my footsteps feel
The warmth with which that single flame can greet.

So wanderer, wherever you may roam,
Remember: somewhere, someone keeps a light.
The brightest beacon is the lamp of home,
That burns with love through even the longest night.

passages.title: Sleep and Memory
passages.text: Scientists have long wondered why human beings spend nearly a third of their lives asleep. Early researchers assumed that the brain simply switches off during sleep, like a machine at night. Modern studies, however, have overturned this belief. During sleep, the brain remains remarkably active, sorting the day's experiences and strengthening those that matter. In one well-known experiment, two groups of students learnt a list of words. One group slept for eight hours afterwards; the other stayed awake. When tested the next day, the sleepers recalled significantly more words. Researchers concluded that sleep does not merely rest the mind but also helps to consolidate memory. Nevertheless, they caution that sleep is not a substitute for study: a student who has not learnt anything cannot expect sleep to store what was never absorbed. Poor sleep, therefore, is not just a matter of tiredness; it quietly weakens learning itself.

questions.question: Choose the correct option to fill the blanks: He is ____ M.A. in English and works as ____ university lecturer.
questions.explanation: 'M.A.' begins with the vowel sound 'em', so 'an' is used. 'University' begins with the consonant sound 'yu', so 'a' is used. Articles depend on sound, not spelling.

questions.question: You ____ have told me earlier; now it is too late to change the plan.
questions.explanation: 'Should have + V3' expresses criticism or regret about something that was not done in the past. 'Must have' shows logical deduction, while 'can/may have' do not fit the sense of regret here.

questions.question: Choose the correct question tag: Let us go for a walk, ____?
questions.explanation: A sentence beginning with 'Let us' (suggestion) takes the tag 'shall we?'. The other forms are not used with this pattern.

questions.question: The cricket match was ____ because of heavy rain.
questions.explanation: 'Call off' means 'to cancel'. 'Call on' means to visit, 'call up' means to telephone or summon, and 'call in' means to ask someone to come and help.

questions.question: Neither the teacher nor the students ____ present in the hall.
questions.explanation: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject. 'Students' is plural, so the plural verb 'were' is correct.

questions.question: I ____ him since he was a child.
questions.explanation: 'Since' with a point in the past and an action continuing to the present takes the present perfect tense: 'have known'. Simple present or simple past cannot show this link.

questions.question: Which of the following sentences contains a non-defining relative clause?
options: The man who called you is waiting outside.
The book that I bought is on the table.
This is the house where I was born.
My brother, who lives in Bilaspur, is a doctor.
questions.explanation: A non-defining clause adds extra information and is separated by commas: 'who lives in Bilaspur'. In the other sentences the clause is needed to identify the noun, so they are defining clauses.

questions.question: Which of the following is the correct complex form of: 'Being tired, he went to bed early.'
options: He was tired and he went to bed early.
He went to bed early, for he was tired.
As he was tired, he went to bed early.
He was tired; therefore, he went to bed early.
questions.explanation: A complex sentence has one main clause and one subordinate clause. 'As he was tired' is a subordinate clause. The other options join two main clauses with and/for/therefore, so they are compound.

questions.question: Change into indirect speech: He said to me, 'Where are you going?'
options: He asked me where was I going.
He asked me where I was going.
He told me where I am going.
He asked me where am I going.
questions.explanation: 'Said to' becomes 'asked' for a question, the word order becomes normal (subject + verb), and the present continuous 'are going' backshifts to 'was going'.

questions.question: Hardly had he reached the station ____ the train left.
questions.explanation: 'Hardly' is always followed by 'when' (Hardly...when). 'Than' is used with 'No sooner'.

questions.question: If he had worked harder, he ____ the examination.
questions.explanation: This is the third conditional (impossible past condition): If + past perfect, would have + V3. The other forms do not match the 'had worked' clause.

questions.question: Choose the full form of the elliptical sentence: 'Ram is taller than I.'
options: Ram is taller than I do.
Ram is taller than I was.
Ram is taller than I am.
Ram is taller than me am.
questions.explanation: The omitted words are 'am tall'. The main clause is in the present tense, so the full form is 'than I am'. 'Do' and 'was' do not fit, and 'me am' is ungrammatical.

questions.question: ____ student in the class has to wear a uniform.
questions.explanation: 'Every' is followed by a singular noun and a singular verb ('has'). 'All', 'both' and 'many' need plural nouns and verbs.

questions.question: He ____ be at home now; I saw his car in the driveway.
questions.explanation: 'Must' expresses strong logical deduction (he is almost certainly at home). 'Can' is not used for positive deduction, 'shall' expresses future/promise, and 'ought' needs 'to'.

questions.question: She hardly ever visits us, ____?
questions.explanation: 'Hardly ever' makes the sentence negative in meaning, so the tag must be positive: 'does she?'. A negative tag would be wrong.

questions.question: Which prefix is added to 'legal' to form its opposite?
questions.explanation: The opposite of 'legal' is 'illegal'. The prefix 'il-' is used before words starting with 'l'. 'Un-', 'im-' and 'in-' do not form a correct word here.

questions.question: Which word is a homophone of 'bear'?
questions.explanation: 'Bear' and 'bare' are both pronounced /beə/ but have different meanings. 'Beer', 'bore' and 'bar' sound different.

questions.question: The Chief Guest ____ a speech at the annual function.
questions.explanation: The natural collocation is 'deliver a speech'. We do not 'do', 'say' or 'tell' a speech.

questions.question: Which is the correct verb form of the adjective 'strong'?
questions.explanation: Strong (adjective) becomes 'strength' (noun) and 'strengthen' (verb). The other forms do not exist in English.

questions.question: Choose the correct word to complete the lexical bundle: 'As a ____ of fact, I have never met him.'
questions.explanation: 'As a matter of fact' is a fixed expression meaning 'actually/in reality'. The other words do not form this bundle.

questions.question: What does the idiom 'to burn the midnight oil' mean?
options: to work or study late into the night
questions.explanation: The idiom means to work or study late at night (originally by the light of an oil lamp). It has no literal meaning of wasting fuel or burning things.

questions.question: Identify the figure of speech: 'I have told you a thousand times not to do that.'
questions.explanation: Hyperbole is deliberate exaggeration for emphasis. The speaker has not literally said it a thousand times. There is no comparison (simile/metaphor) and no opposite meaning (irony).

questions.question: Which suffix is added to the verb 'govern' to form a noun?
questions.explanation: Govern + -ment = government. The suffixes -ness, -ous and -ful do not form a noun from this verb.

questions.question: In the sentence 'The referee's decision was fair', the word 'fair' means:
questions.explanation: 'Fair' is a polysemous word. In this sentence it means 'just/impartial'. The other meanings (beautiful, light-skinned, a fair/mela) do not suit the context.

questions.question: The road was blocked by ____ traffic during the festival.
questions.explanation: 'Heavy traffic' is the standard collocation. 'Thick', 'strong' and 'large' do not collocate with 'traffic'.

questions.question: In which sentence is the word 'water' used as a verb?
options: She filled the bottle with water.
questions.explanation: In 'Please water the plants daily', 'water' is an action word (verb) meaning to give water. In the other sentences it is a noun (or a noun used as a modifier).

questions.question: Complete the bundle: 'It goes ____ saying that honesty is the best policy.'
questions.explanation: 'It goes without saying' is a fixed expression meaning 'it is obvious'. The other prepositions do not form the bundle.

questions.question: What does the idiom 'a blessing in disguise' mean?
options: a misfortune that later proves to be beneficial
questions.explanation: The idiom refers to something that seems bad at first but brings a good result later. The other options take the words literally.

questions.question: Identify the figure of speech in 'The pen is mightier than the sword.'
questions.explanation: Metonymy replaces a thing by something closely associated with it: 'pen' stands for writing/the written word and 'sword' for military force. There is no 'like/as' (simile), repeated initial sound or imitation of a sound.

questions.question: Which is the adverb form of the adjective 'good'?
questions.explanation: The adverb of 'good' is 'well'. 'Goodness' is a noun, 'goodly' is an adjective, and 'better' is a comparative form.

questions.question: What is the central idea of the passage 'The Leaning Shelves'?
options: Modernisation is always harmful to villages.
A humble library near their homes mattered deeply to the villagers, and they protected it.
A librarian is more important than books.
questions.explanation: The passage shows villagers politely resisting the shifting of their small library. The other options are not supported: children love reading, modernisation is not condemned, and the librarian is not ranked above books.

questions.question: What did the farmer mean by saying 'A book is borrowed with the feet before it is borrowed with the hands'?
options: Readers must be able to reach the library easily on foot.
Books are too heavy to carry.
Children like to run to the library.
He wanted to walk to the new building for exercise.
questions.explanation: The farmer means that a person has to walk to the library first before borrowing; if it is far away, villagers cannot use it. The other options miss this point.

questions.question: The word 'withdrawn' in the last sentence of the passage means:
questions.explanation: The government gave up its idea, so the proposal was 'taken back'. 'Approved' and 'extended' are opposite or unrelated, and 'delayed' means postponed.

questions.question: 'The shelves leaned like tired old men' is an example of:
questions.explanation: A comparison made with the word 'like' is a simile. A metaphor would say the shelves 'were' tired old men.

questions.question: How is the villagers' protest described in the passage?
questions.explanation: The passage says they 'protested politely but firmly'. Nothing suggests violence, weakness or disorder.

questions.question: What is the central theme of the poem?
options: The fear of travelling in cities
The comforting pull of home and a mother's love
The beauty of the night sky
questions.explanation: The poem ends by calling the lamp of home the brightest beacon that burns with love. The storm and stars are only background.

questions.question: 'That little light calls gently through the pain.' Which figure of speech is used here?
questions.explanation: A lamp cannot call; giving it a human action is personification. There is no comparison word, exaggeration, or contradictory pair of words.

questions.question: The word 'beacon' in the last stanza means:
questions.explanation: A beacon is a light that guides or warns. It does not mean a bell, a shelter or a weapon.

questions.question: Why can the city lamps not make the poet's footsteps 'feel the warmth' of the single flame?
options: The mother's lamp carries personal love that city lights lack.
questions.explanation: The poet contrasts thousands of lamps with the one lit by his mother; the difference is the emotional warmth of love, not brightness or safety.

questions.question: What is the tone of the poem?
questions.explanation: The speaker remembers home and mother with affection, so the tone is nostalgic and tender. There is no anger, humour or coldness.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the passage 'Sleep and Memory'?
options: Sleep is a waste of time.
Students should sleep instead of studying.
The brain completely stops working during sleep.
Sleep actively helps the brain to consolidate what has been learnt.
questions.explanation: The passage says the brain stays active in sleep and strengthens memories. The other options contradict the passage.

questions.question: A student who sleeps poorly after learning a lesson would most probably:
options: recall fewer things the next day
recall more things the next day
questions.explanation: Since sleep strengthens memory, poor sleep would weaken recall. The other options are not supported by the passage.

questions.question: The word 'overturned' in the passage is closest in meaning to:
questions.explanation: Modern studies reversed the old belief, so 'overturned' means reversed/disproved.

questions.question: Arrange the steps of the experiment in the correct order: P. Students learnt a list of words. Q. One group slept while the other stayed awake. R. All students were tested the next day. S. The sleepers recalled more words.
questions.explanation: Learning came first (P), then the sleep/no-sleep condition (Q), then the test (R), and finally the result (S). So the order is PQRS.

questions.question: Which statement agrees with the writer's view?
options: The brain stops working during sleep.
Both groups recalled an equal number of words.
Sleep cannot store what was never learnt.
questions.explanation: The writer cautions that sleep is no substitute for study; it cannot store what was never absorbed. The other statements contradict the passage.

questions.question: According to Krashen, 'acquisition' differs from 'learning' because acquisition is:
questions.questionHi: क्रैशन (Krashen) के अनुसार 'अर्जन' (acquisition) और 'अधिगम' (learning) में अंतर यह है कि अर्जन:
options: a conscious study of grammar rules
a subconscious process of picking up a language through meaningful communication
correcting errors with the teacher's help
optionsHi: व्याकरण के नियमों का सचेत अध्ययन है
सार्थक संप्रेषण के माध्यम से भाषा को अनजाने में सीखने की प्रक्रिया है
शब्दों की सूची अर्थ सहित रटना है
शिक्षक की सहायता से त्रुटियाँ सुधारना है
questions.explanation: Acquisition is a natural, subconscious process, like a child picking up the mother tongue. Learning is conscious study of rules. The other options describe learning-type activities.
questions.explanationHi: अर्जन एक स्वाभाविक और अचेतन प्रक्रिया है, जैसे बच्चा मातृभाषा सीखता है। अधिगम में नियमों का सचेत अध्ययन होता है। अन्य विकल्प अधिगम जैसी गतिविधियाँ हैं।

questions.question: Which theory views language learning as habit formation through stimulus, response and reinforcement?
questions.questionHi: कौन-सा सिद्धांत भाषा सीखने को उद्दीपक, अनुक्रिया और पुनर्बलन द्वारा आदत निर्माण मानता है?
questions.explanation: Skinner's behaviourism explains language as learnt through imitation, practice and reinforcement. Chomsky stresses innate ability, Vygotsky social interaction, and Piaget cognitive development.
questions.explanationHi: स्किनर का व्यवहारवाद भाषा को अनुकरण, अभ्यास और पुनर्बलन से सीखा गया मानता है। चॉम्स्की जन्मजात क्षमता, वाइगोत्स्की सामाजिक संवाद और पियाजे संज्ञानात्मक विकास पर बल देते हैं।

questions.question: Chomsky argued that children acquire grammar quickly mainly because:
questions.questionHi: चॉम्स्की के अनुसार बच्चे व्याकरण को शीघ्रता से मुख्यतः इसलिए सीख लेते हैं क्योंकि:
options: they are born with an innate language faculty (LAD)
they imitate every sentence they hear
they are rewarded for correct speech
optionsHi: वे जन्म से ही एक जन्मजात भाषा-क्षमता (LAD) लेकर आते हैं
माता-पिता उन्हें औपचारिक रूप से नियम सिखाते हैं
वे सुने गए हर वाक्य की नकल करते हैं
सही बोलने पर उन्हें पुरस्कार मिलता है
questions.explanation: Chomsky proposed the Language Acquisition Device (LAD) or Universal Grammar. Imitation, formal teaching and rewards cannot explain how children produce new sentences they have never heard.
questions.explanationHi: चॉम्स्की ने भाषा अर्जन युक्ति (LAD) या सार्वभौमिक व्याकरण का सिद्धांत दिया। नकल, औपचारिक शिक्षण या पुरस्कार से यह नहीं समझाया जा सकता कि बच्चे ऐसे नए वाक्य कैसे बनाते हैं जो उन्होंने कभी सुने ही नहीं।

questions.question: The distance between what a learner can do alone and what he can do with help is called:
questions.questionHi: जो काम शिक्षार्थी अकेले कर सकता है और जो सहायता से कर सकता है, उनके बीच की दूरी कहलाती है:
questions.explanation: Vygotsky's Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD) is the gap between independent performance and performance with guidance. The other terms belong to different ideas.
questions.explanationHi: वाइगोत्स्की का ZPD स्वतंत्र प्रदर्शन और मार्गदर्शन सहित प्रदर्शन के बीच का अंतर है। अन्य शब्द दूसरी अवधारणाओं से जुड़े हैं।

questions.question: According to Krashen, a high 'affective filter' (anxiety, low motivation) results in:
questions.questionHi: क्रैशन के अनुसार उच्च 'भावात्मक छन्नी' (चिंता, कम प्रेरणा) का परिणाम होता है:
options: input being blocked and acquisition being hindered
a better working of the monitor
optionsHi: इनपुट का रुक जाना और अर्जन में बाधा आना
questions.explanation: A high affective filter acts like a wall that stops input from reaching the acquisition system. A low filter (relaxed, motivated learner) helps acquisition.
questions.explanationHi: उच्च भावात्मक छन्नी दीवार की तरह इनपुट को अर्जन तंत्र तक पहुँचने से रोकती है। कम छन्नी (तनावमुक्त, प्रेरित शिक्षार्थी) अर्जन में सहायक होती है।

questions.question: Bruner's concept of 'scaffolding' refers to:
questions.questionHi: ब्रूनर की 'स्कैफ़ोल्डिंग' (scaffolding) की अवधारणा का अर्थ है:
options: temporary support given by a teacher or peers that is gradually withdrawn
a fixed set of drill sentences
optionsHi: शिक्षक या साथियों द्वारा दिया गया अस्थायी सहारा, जिसे धीरे-धीरे हटा लिया जाता है
questions.explanation: Scaffolding is temporary guided support that helps a learner do a task slightly beyond his present ability, and it is reduced as competence grows.
questions.explanationHi: स्कैफ़ोल्डिंग वह अस्थायी निर्देशित सहायता है जो शिक्षार्थी को उसकी वर्तमान क्षमता से थोड़ा कठिन कार्य करने में मदद देती है और क्षमता बढ़ने पर घटा दी जाती है।

questions.question: The smallest meaningful unit of a language is called a:
questions.questionHi: भाषा की सबसे छोटी सार्थक इकाई कहलाती है:
questions.explanation: A morpheme (e.g. 'un-', 'happy', '-ness') is the smallest unit with meaning. A phoneme is the smallest unit of sound and does not carry meaning by itself.
questions.explanationHi: रूपिम (जैसे un-, happy, -ness) अर्थ वाली सबसे छोटी इकाई है। स्वनिम ध्वनि की सबसे छोटी इकाई है और अपने आप में अर्थ नहीं रखती।

questions.question: The evolving language system of a learner, lying between the mother tongue and the target language, is known as:
questions.questionHi: शिक्षार्थी की वह विकसित होती भाषा-प्रणाली, जो मातृभाषा और लक्ष्य भाषा के बीच होती है, कहलाती है:
questions.explanation: Selinker called this learner system 'interlanguage'. A dialect is a regional variety, a register is a style suited to a situation, and a pidgin is a simplified contact language.
questions.explanationHi: सेलिंकर ने इस शिक्षार्थी-प्रणाली को 'अंतर्भाषा' कहा। बोली क्षेत्रीय रूप है, रजिस्टर परिस्थिति के अनुसार शैली है और पिजिन संपर्क से बनी सरल भाषा है।

questions.question: Which sequence reflects the natural order in which language skills develop in a child?
questions.questionHi: कौन-सा क्रम बच्चे में भाषा-कौशलों के स्वाभाविक विकास को दर्शाता है?
questions.explanation: A child first listens, then speaks, and only later learns to read and write. Listening therefore forms the base of all language learning.
questions.explanationHi: बच्चा पहले सुनता है, फिर बोलता है और बाद में पढ़ना-लिखना सीखता है। इसलिए सुनना सभी भाषा-अधिगम की नींव है।

questions.question: The modern view on teaching grammar in English language teaching is that grammar should be:
questions.questionHi: अंग्रेज़ी शिक्षण में व्याकरण पढ़ाने के बारे में आधुनिक दृष्टिकोण यह है कि व्याकरण:
options: taught as isolated rules to be memorised
taught in context to help learners communicate meaningfully
optionsHi: अलग-थलग नियमों के रूप में रटाया जाए
संदर्भ में पढ़ाया जाए ताकि शिक्षार्थी सार्थक संप्रेषण कर सकें
questions.explanation: Grammar is a tool for communication and is best learnt in context (functional grammar). Memorising isolated rules or avoiding grammar entirely does not help communication.
questions.explanationHi: व्याकरण संप्रेषण का साधन है और संदर्भ में सबसे अच्छा सीखा जाता है। नियम रटना या व्याकरण को पूरी तरह छोड़ना संप्रेषण में सहायक नहीं है।

questions.question: Which method uses the mother tongue extensively, focuses on translation and rules, and gives little oral practice?
questions.questionHi: कौन-सी विधि मातृभाषा का बहुत प्रयोग करती है, अनुवाद और नियमों पर ध्यान देती है तथा मौखिक अभ्यास कम कराती है?
questions.explanation: The Grammar-Translation Method teaches through rules and translation using the mother tongue. The Direct Method avoids the mother tongue, and the Audio-lingual and Communicative approaches stress speaking.
questions.explanationHi: व्याकरण-अनुवाद विधि मातृभाषा द्वारा नियमों और अनुवाद से पढ़ाती है। प्रत्यक्ष विधि मातृभाषा से बचती है तथा श्रव्य-भाषिक और संप्रेषणात्मक उपागम बोलने पर बल देते हैं।

questions.question: In Task-Based Language Teaching (TBLT), learners mainly learn English by:
questions.questionHi: कार्य-आधारित भाषा शिक्षण (TBLT) में शिक्षार्थी अंग्रेज़ी मुख्यतः किसके द्वारा सीखते हैं?
options: completing meaningful tasks, such as planning a trip, using the language
optionsHi: भाषा का प्रयोग करते हुए सार्थक कार्य (जैसे यात्रा की योजना बनाना) पूरे करके
questions.explanation: TBLT organises learning around real-life tasks where language is a means to complete the task. Memorising, translating and repeating drills belong to older methods.
questions.explanationHi: TBLT में अधिगम वास्तविक जीवन के कार्यों के आसपास संगठित होता है, जहाँ भाषा कार्य पूरा करने का साधन है। रटना, अनुवाद और ड्रिल दोहराना पुरानी विधियों की विशेषताएँ हैं।

questions.question: Pattern drills and repetition are most characteristic of:
questions.questionHi: पैटर्न ड्रिल और दोहराव किसकी सबसे प्रमुख विशेषता हैं?
questions.explanation: The Audio-lingual Method is based on behaviourism and uses repetitive pattern drills to build habits. The other approaches do not rely mainly on drills.
questions.explanationHi: श्रव्य-भाषिक विधि व्यवहारवाद पर आधारित है और आदत बनाने के लिए दोहराव वाले पैटर्न ड्रिल का प्रयोग करती है। अन्य उपागम मुख्यतः ड्रिल पर निर्भर नहीं हैं।

questions.question: How is a 'mistake' different from an 'error' in language learning?
questions.questionHi: भाषा सीखने में 'mistake' (भूल) और 'error' (त्रुटि) में क्या अंतर है?
options: A mistake is a systematic result of incomplete knowledge of a rule.
A mistake is a random slip which the learner can correct when it is pointed out.
A mistake always results from the mother tongue.
A mistake shows that the learner has never been taught English.
optionsHi: भूल किसी नियम के अधूरे ज्ञान का व्यवस्थित परिणाम होती है।
भूल एक आकस्मिक चूक है जिसे बताए जाने पर शिक्षार्थी स्वयं सुधार सकता है।
भूल हमेशा मातृभाषा के कारण होती है।
भूल दर्शाती है कि शिक्षार्थी को कभी अंग्रेज़ी सिखाई ही नहीं गई।
questions.explanation: Mistakes are performance slips (tiredness, carelessness) that the learner can self-correct, whereas errors are systematic and show a gap in competence. The other statements are not accurate.
questions.explanationHi: भूलें प्रदर्शन की चूकें हैं (थकान, असावधानी) जिन्हें शिक्षार्थी स्वयं सुधार सकता है, जबकि त्रुटियाँ व्यवस्थित होती हैं और दक्षता की कमी दर्शाती हैं। अन्य कथन सही नहीं हैं।

questions.question: Remedial teaching in English is most effective when it is planned after:
questions.questionHi: अंग्रेज़ी में उपचारात्मक शिक्षण तब सबसे प्रभावी होता है जब उसकी योजना किसके बाद बनाई जाए?
options: diagnosing the specific difficulty of the learner
optionsHi: शिक्षार्थी की विशिष्ट कठिनाई का निदान करने के
सभी शिक्षार्थियों का गृहकार्य बढ़ाने के
questions.explanation: Remedial teaching must follow diagnosis of the exact weakness so that instruction targets it. Punishment or extra homework for everyone does not address individual difficulties.
questions.explanationHi: उपचारात्मक शिक्षण तभी सफल होता है जब पहले सही कमज़ोरी का निदान किया जाए। दंड या सभी को अधिक गृहकार्य देने से व्यक्तिगत कठिनाइयाँ दूर नहीं होतीं।

questions.question: A child who understands conservation of quantity, but only with concrete objects, is in which Piagetian stage?
questions.questionHi: जो बच्चा मात्रा के संरक्षण को समझता है, परंतु केवल ठोस वस्तुओं के साथ, वह पियाजे की किस अवस्था में है?
questions.explanation: Conservation develops in the concrete operational stage (about 7 to 11 years), when logical thinking is applied to concrete objects. Preoperational children lack conservation, and formal operational thinkers handle abstract ideas.
questions.explanationHi: संरक्षण की समझ मूर्त संक्रियात्मक अवस्था (लगभग 7 से 11 वर्ष) में विकसित होती है, जब तार्किक चिंतन ठोस वस्तुओं पर लागू होता है। पूर्व-संक्रियात्मक अवस्था में संरक्षण नहीं होता और औपचारिक अवस्था में अमूर्त विचार संभव होते हैं।

questions.question: According to Erikson, the main crisis of adolescence is:
questions.questionHi: एरिक्सन के अनुसार किशोरावस्था का मुख्य संकट है:
questions.explanation: Adolescents ask 'Who am I?', so the crisis is identity versus role confusion. Trust vs mistrust belongs to infancy, industry vs inferiority to school age and integrity vs despair to old age.
questions.explanationHi: किशोर पूछता है 'मैं कौन हूँ?', इसलिए संकट पहचान बनाम भूमिका भ्रम है। विश्वास बनाम अविश्वास शैशवावस्था का, उद्यमिता बनाम हीनता विद्यालय-आयु का और अखंडता बनाम निराशा वृद्धावस्था का संकट है।

questions.question: In Kohlberg's theory, the 'law and order orientation' belongs to which level of moral development?
questions.questionHi: कोहलबर्ग के सिद्धांत में 'कानून और व्यवस्था अभिविन्यास' नैतिक विकास के किस स्तर का भाग है?
questions.explanation: The law and order orientation (Stage 4) lies in the conventional level, where a person obeys rules to maintain social order. Pre-conventional is based on punishment and reward, post-conventional on universal principles.
questions.explanationHi: कानून और व्यवस्था अभिविन्यास (चरण 4) रूढ़िगत स्तर में आता है, जहाँ व्यक्ति सामाजिक व्यवस्था बनाए रखने के लिए नियम मानता है। पूर्व-रूढ़िगत स्तर दंड-पुरस्कार पर और उत्तर-रूढ़िगत स्तर सार्वभौमिक सिद्धांतों पर आधारित है।

questions.question: Bandura's famous 'Bobo doll' experiment demonstrated:
questions.questionHi: बंडूरा के प्रसिद्ध 'बोबो डॉल' प्रयोग ने क्या प्रदर्शित किया?
questions.explanation: Children imitated the aggressive behaviour of an adult model, showing learning by observation. Classical conditioning is Pavlov's, trial and error is Thorndike's, and insight learning is Gestalt (Kohler).
questions.explanationHi: बच्चों ने वयस्क आदर्श के आक्रामक व्यवहार की नकल की, जो अवलोकन द्वारा सीखना दर्शाता है। शास्त्रीय अनुबंधन पावलोव का, प्रयास-त्रुटि थॉर्नडाइक का और अंतर्दृष्टि अधिगम गेस्टाल्ट (कोहलर) का है।

questions.question: Who proposed the Triarchic theory of intelligence?
questions.questionHi: बुद्धि के त्रिचापीय (Triarchic) सिद्धांत का प्रतिपादन किसने किया?
questions.explanation: Robert Sternberg proposed the Triarchic theory (analytical, creative and practical intelligence). Spearman gave the two-factor theory, Gardner multiple intelligences, and Binet the first intelligence test.
questions.explanationHi: रॉबर्ट स्टर्नबर्ग ने त्रिचापीय सिद्धांत (विश्लेषणात्मक, सृजनात्मक और व्यावहारिक बुद्धि) दिया। स्पीयरमैन ने द्विकारक सिद्धांत, गार्डनर ने बहुबुद्धि सिद्धांत और बिने ने पहला बुद्धि परीक्षण दिया।

questions.question: In Maslow's hierarchy of needs, the highest need is:
questions.questionHi: मैस्लो की आवश्यकता पदानुक्रम में सबसे ऊँची आवश्यकता है:
questions.explanation: Self-actualisation (realising one's full potential) is at the top. Safety and belongingness are lower-level needs, and esteem comes just below self-actualisation.
questions.explanationHi: आत्म-सिद्धि (अपनी पूरी क्षमता को पहचानना) सबसे ऊपर है। सुरक्षा और अपनत्व निचले स्तर की आवश्यकताएँ हैं और सम्मान की आवश्यकता आत्म-सिद्धि के ठीक नीचे आती है।

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of formative assessment?
questions.questionHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा रचनात्मक (formative) आकलन का उदाहरण है?
options: A class quiz followed by immediate feedback
optionsHi: कक्षा क्विज़, जिसके बाद तुरंत फीडबैक दिया जाए
questions.explanation: Formative assessment takes place during learning and gives feedback to improve it. Board exams, final results and entrance tests are summative or selective in nature.
questions.explanationHi: रचनात्मक आकलन सीखने की प्रक्रिया के दौरान होता है और सुधार के लिए फीडबैक देता है। बोर्ड परीक्षा, अंतिम परिणाम और प्रवेश परीक्षा योगात्मक या चयन प्रकृति के हैं।

questions.question: If a test gives consistent results when administered repeatedly under similar conditions, it is said to be:
questions.questionHi: यदि कोई परीक्षण समान परिस्थितियों में बार-बार लेने पर समान परिणाम देता है, तो उसे कहा जाता है:
questions.explanation: Consistency of results is reliability. Validity means the test measures what it is meant to measure, objectivity means freedom from scorer bias, and usability means practicality.
questions.explanationHi: परिणामों की स्थिरता विश्वसनीयता है। वैधता का अर्थ है कि परीक्षण वही मापे जो मापना चाहिए, वस्तुनिष्ठता का अर्थ है जाँचकर्ता के पक्षपात से मुक्ति और उपयोगिता का अर्थ है व्यावहारिकता।

questions.question: A test in which a student's score is interpreted by comparing it with the scores of other students is:
questions.questionHi: वह परीक्षण जिसमें विद्यार्थी के अंकों की व्याख्या अन्य विद्यार्थियों के अंकों से तुलना करके की जाती है:
questions.explanation: Norm-referenced tests rank a learner against a peer group. Criterion-referenced tests compare performance with a fixed standard, and diagnostic tests find specific weaknesses.
questions.explanationHi: मानक-संदर्भित परीक्षण विद्यार्थी को समूह के अन्य विद्यार्थियों के सापेक्ष रखता है। मानदंड-संदर्भित परीक्षण निश्चित मानक से तुलना करता है और निदानात्मक परीक्षण विशिष्ट कमज़ोरियाँ खोजता है।

questions.question: A scoring guide that lists criteria and describes different levels of performance for each criterion is called a:
questions.questionHi: वह अंकन-निर्देशिका जिसमें मानदंड और प्रत्येक मानदंड के लिए प्रदर्शन के विभिन्न स्तरों का वर्णन होता है, कहलाती है:
questions.explanation: A rubric gives criteria with performance levels. A checklist only records presence or absence of a skill, an anecdotal record is a note on an incident, and a portfolio is a collection of student work.
questions.explanationHi: रूब्रिक में मानदंडों के साथ प्रदर्शन-स्तर दिए जाते हैं। जाँच-सूची केवल किसी कौशल की उपस्थिति/अनुपस्थिति दर्शाती है, घटना-अभिलेख किसी घटना का नोट है और पोर्टफोलियो विद्यार्थी के कार्य का संग्रह है।

questions.question: Which of the following is an aim emphasised by NCF 2005?
questions.questionHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा लक्ष्य NCF 2005 में विशेष रूप से बताया गया है?
options: Heavy dependence on a single textbook
Connecting knowledge to life outside the school
optionsHi: एक ही पाठ्यपुस्तक पर अत्यधिक निर्भरता
ज्ञान को विद्यालय के बाहर के जीवन से जोड़ना
questions.explanation: NCF 2005 stresses linking learning with life outside school, reducing rote learning and making learners active constructors of knowledge. The other options are what it opposes.
questions.explanationHi: NCF 2005 सीखने को विद्यालय के बाहर के जीवन से जोड़ने, रटंत प्रणाली को कम करने और विद्यार्थियों को ज्ञान का सक्रिय निर्माता बनाने पर बल देता है। अन्य विकल्प वे बातें हैं जिनका वह विरोध करता है।

questions.question: A lesson plan is best described as:
questions.questionHi: पाठ योजना का सर्वोत्तम वर्णन है:
options: a teacher's advance blueprint of objectives, activities and assessment for a lesson
a list of questions for the final exam
optionsHi: किसी पाठ के उद्देश्यों, गतिविधियों और आकलन की शिक्षक द्वारा पहले से बनाई गई रूपरेखा
अंतिम परीक्षा के प्रश्नों की सूची
अभिभावकों को भेजी जाने वाली रिपोर्ट
questions.explanation: A lesson plan is the teacher's prior plan of what to teach, how to teach and how to assess. Attendance records, exam question lists and parent reports serve other purposes.
questions.explanationHi: पाठ योजना शिक्षक की पूर्व योजना है कि क्या पढ़ाना है, कैसे पढ़ाना है और कैसे आकलन करना है। उपस्थिति अभिलेख, परीक्षा-प्रश्न सूची और अभिभावक रिपोर्ट के उद्देश्य अलग हैं।

questions.question: Which of the following is a learner-centred teaching method?
questions.questionHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी शिक्षार्थी-केंद्रित शिक्षण विधि है?
questions.explanation: In the project method, learners plan and carry out an activity themselves. Lecture, dictation and rote methods are teacher-centred.
questions.explanationHi: प्रोजेक्ट विधि में शिक्षार्थी स्वयं किसी गतिविधि की योजना बनाकर उसे पूरा करते हैं। व्याख्यान, श्रुतलेख और रटंत विधियाँ शिक्षक-केंद्रित हैं।

questions.question: In a constructivist classroom, the teacher mainly acts as a:
questions.questionHi: रचनावादी कक्षा में शिक्षक मुख्यतः किस रूप में कार्य करता है?
questions.explanation: Constructivism sees learners as active builders of knowledge, so the teacher guides and facilitates. An authority, dictator or mere examiner would make learning passive.
questions.explanationHi: रचनावाद में शिक्षार्थी ज्ञान के सक्रिय निर्माता माने जाते हैं, इसलिए शिक्षक मार्गदर्शन और सुगमन करता है। अधिकारी, तानाशाह या केवल परीक्षक की भूमिका अधिगम को निष्क्रिय बना देती है।

questions.question: Which practice best promotes gender equality in the classroom?
questions.questionHi: कक्षा में लैंगिक समानता को कौन-सी प्रथा सबसे अच्छी तरह बढ़ावा देती है?
options: Assigning cooking tasks only to girls in school events
Giving boys and girls equal opportunities in all activities
Seating boys and girls in different rooms always
Expecting boys to perform better in science
optionsHi: विद्यालय के आयोजनों में केवल लड़कियों को भोजन बनाने का कार्य देना
सभी गतिविधियों में लड़कों और लड़कियों को समान अवसर देना
लड़कों और लड़कियों को हमेशा अलग कमरों में बैठाना
लड़कों से विज्ञान में बेहतर प्रदर्शन की अपेक्षा करना
questions.explanation: Equal opportunities remove stereotypes. The other options reinforce gender bias.
questions.explanationHi: समान अवसर रूढ़ियों को दूर करते हैं। अन्य विकल्प लैंगिक पूर्वाग्रह को बढ़ाते हैं।

questions.question: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा वर्ण स्वर नहीं है?
questions.explanation: 'ई', 'ऊ' और 'ए' स्वर हैं, जबकि 'क' व्यंजन है। इसलिए 'क' सही उत्तर है।

questions.question: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा शब्द पुल्लिंग है?
questions.explanation: 'दही' पुल्लिंग शब्द है (यह दही मीठा है)। 'रोटी', 'नदी' और 'चींटी' स्त्रीलिंग शब्द हैं।

questions.question: 'मैं स्वयं यह काम करूँगा।' - इस वाक्य में 'स्वयं' कौन-सा सर्वनाम है?
questions.explanation: जो सर्वनाम कर्ता के साथ आकर उसी का बोध कराए (आप, स्वयं, खुद), उसे निजवाचक सर्वनाम कहते हैं। अन्य विकल्प यहाँ लागू नहीं होते।

questions.question: 'राजपुत्र' में कौन-सा समास है?
questions.explanation: 'राजपुत्र' का विग्रह 'राजा का पुत्र' है। इसमें उत्तरपद प्रधान है और संबंध कारक की विभक्ति लुप्त है, इसलिए यह तत्पुरुष समास है।

questions.question: 'सूर्योदय' का संधि-विच्छेद क्या है?
questions.explanation: सूर्य + उदय = सूर्योदय। यहाँ 'अ' और 'उ' मिलकर 'ओ' बनते हैं, यह गुण संधि का उदाहरण है। अन्य विकल्प शब्दों को गलत तोड़ते हैं।

questions.question: What is the plural form of 'phenomenon'?
questions.explanation: 'Phenomenon' is of Greek origin and its plural is 'phenomena'. The other forms are incorrect.

questions.question: He is very fond ____ classical music.
questions.explanation: The adjective 'fond' is followed by the preposition 'of' (fond of). The other prepositions do not collocate with 'fond'.

questions.question: Choose the synonym of 'ABUNDANT'.
questions.explanation: 'Abundant' means existing in large quantities, so 'plentiful' is its synonym. 'Scarce' is its antonym; 'tiny' and 'costly' are unrelated.

questions.question: One-word substitution for 'a person who can speak many languages':
questions.explanation: A polyglot is a person who knows several languages. An orator is a skilled public speaker, a bibliophile loves books, and a pedant is overly concerned with minor details.

questions.question: Change into passive voice: 'They are building a bridge.'
options: A bridge was being built by them.
A bridge is built by them.
A bridge is being built by them.
A bridge has been built by them.
questions.explanation: The present continuous active ('are building') becomes 'is/are being + V3' in the passive. So 'A bridge is being built by them' is correct. The other options change the tense.

questions.question: Doctor : Hospital :: Teacher : ?
questions.questionHi: डॉक्टर : अस्पताल :: शिक्षक : ?
questions.explanation: A doctor works in a hospital, just as a teacher works in a school. The relationship is person and workplace.
questions.explanationHi: डॉक्टर अस्पताल में कार्य करता है, उसी प्रकार शिक्षक विद्यालय में कार्य करता है। संबंध व्यक्ति और कार्यस्थल का है।

questions.question: Find the next number in the series: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
questions.explanation: The differences are 4, 6, 8, 10, so the next difference is 12. Hence 30 + 12 = 42. (The terms are 1x2, 2x3, 3x4, 4x5, 5x6, 6x7.)

questions.question: A is the sister of B, and B is the father of C. How is A related to C?
questions.questionHi: A, B की बहन है और B, C का पिता है। A का C से क्या संबंध है?
questions.explanation: A is the sister of C's father B, so A is C's paternal aunt (bua).
questions.explanationHi: A, C के पिता B की बहन है, इसलिए A, C की बुआ है।

questions.question: Ravi walks 5 km north, then turns right and walks 3 km, then turns right again and walks 5 km. How far and in which direction is he from the starting point?
questions.questionHi: रवि 5 किमी उत्तर की ओर चलता है, फिर दाएँ मुड़कर 3 किमी चलता है, फिर दोबारा दाएँ मुड़कर 5 किमी चलता है। वह प्रारंभिक बिंदु से कितनी दूर और किस दिशा में है?
questions.explanation: North 5 km, right turn means east 3 km, another right turn means south 5 km. The 5 km north and south cancel, leaving him 3 km east of the start.
questions.explanationHi: 5 किमी उत्तर, दाएँ मुड़ने पर 3 किमी पूर्व, फिर दाएँ मुड़ने पर 5 किमी दक्षिण। उत्तर और दक्षिण की 5-5 किमी दूरियाँ कट जाती हैं, इसलिए वह प्रारंभ से 3 किमी पूर्व में है।

questions.question: In a certain code, 'MAN' is written as 'NBO'. How will 'BOY' be written in that code?
questions.questionHi: एक कूट भाषा में 'MAN' को 'NBO' लिखा जाता है। उसी कूट में 'BOY' को कैसे लिखा जाएगा?
questions.explanation: Each letter is moved one place forward: M to N, A to B, N to O. So B to C, O to P, Y to Z, giving CPZ.
questions.explanationHi: प्रत्येक अक्षर को एक स्थान आगे बढ़ाया गया है: M से N, A से B, N से O। इसलिए B से C, O से P, Y से Z, अर्थात CPZ।

questions.question: Which part of the computer is called its 'brain'?
questions.questionHi: कंप्यूटर के किस भाग को उसका 'मस्तिष्क' कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: The CPU (Central Processing Unit) processes instructions and controls all operations, so it is called the brain. The monitor and keyboard are output and input devices, and RAM is memory.
questions.explanationHi: CPU (केंद्रीय प्रसंस्करण इकाई) निर्देशों को संसाधित करती है और सभी कार्यों को नियंत्रित करती है, इसलिए इसे मस्तिष्क कहते हैं। मॉनीटर और कीबोर्ड आउटपुट व इनपुट उपकरण हैं तथा RAM मेमोरी है।

questions.question: Which of the following is a volatile memory?
questions.questionHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी वाष्पशील (volatile) मेमोरी है?
questions.explanation: RAM loses its data when the power is switched off, so it is volatile. ROM, hard disk and pen drive keep their data without power.
questions.explanationHi: बिजली बंद होने पर RAM का डेटा मिट जाता है, इसलिए यह वाष्पशील है। ROM, हार्ड डिस्क और पेन ड्राइव बिना बिजली के भी डेटा सुरक्षित रखते हैं।

questions.question: Which of the following is an output device?
questions.questionHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा आउटपुट उपकरण है?
questions.explanation: A printer produces printed output from the computer. A scanner, mouse and keyboard are input devices.
questions.explanationHi: प्रिंटर कंप्यूटर से मुद्रित आउटपुट देता है। स्कैनर, माउस और कीबोर्ड इनपुट उपकरण हैं।

questions.question: In an e-mail, the recipients listed in the BCC field:
questions.questionHi: ई-मेल में BCC फ़ील्ड में लिखे गए प्राप्तकर्ता:
options: are visible to all other recipients
are hidden from the other recipients
do not receive a copy of the mail
are the main recipients of the mail
optionsHi: अन्य सभी प्राप्तकर्ताओं को दिखाई देते हैं
अन्य प्राप्तकर्ताओं से छिपे रहते हैं
मेल की प्रति प्राप्त नहीं करते
मेल के मुख्य प्राप्तकर्ता होते हैं
questions.explanation: BCC means Blind Carbon Copy. Those addressed in BCC receive the mail, but their addresses are not shown to the other recipients.
questions.explanationHi: BCC का अर्थ है ब्लाइंड कार्बन कॉपी। BCC वाले लोगों को मेल मिलता है, परंतु उनके पते अन्य प्राप्तकर्ताओं को नहीं दिखते।

questions.question: Which of the following is an open-source operating system?
questions.questionHi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा ओपन-सोर्स ऑपरेटिंग सिस्टम है?
questions.explanation: Linux is open-source; its source code is freely available. MS-DOS, Windows and macOS are proprietary systems.
questions.explanationHi: लिनक्स ओपन-सोर्स है; इसका स्रोत कोड सभी के लिए उपलब्ध है। MS-DOS, विंडोज़ और macOS स्वामित्व वाले (proprietary) सिस्टम हैं।

questions.question: The Right to Constitutional Remedies is guaranteed under which Article of the Indian Constitution?
questions.questionHi: भारतीय संविधान के किस अनुच्छेद में संवैधानिक उपचारों का अधिकार दिया गया है?
questions.explanation: Article 32 gives the right to move the Supreme Court for enforcement of Fundamental Rights; Dr Ambedkar called it the 'heart and soul' of the Constitution. Article 14 is equality before law, Article 21 is right to life, and Article 44 is a Directive Principle on a uniform civil code.
questions.explanationHi: अनुच्छेद 32 मौलिक अधिकारों को लागू कराने के लिए सर्वोच्च न्यायालय जाने का अधिकार देता है; डॉ. अंबेडकर ने इसे संविधान की 'आत्मा और हृदय' कहा। अनुच्छेद 14 विधि के समक्ष समानता, 21 जीवन का अधिकार और 44 समान नागरिक संहिता का नीति-निर्देशक तत्व है।

questions.question: On which date did Chhattisgarh become a separate state?
questions.questionHi: छत्तीसगढ़ किस तिथि को अलग राज्य बना?
questions.explanation: Chhattisgarh was carved out of Madhya Pradesh on 1 November 2000 and is celebrated as Rajyotsava; its capital is Raipur. The other dates are incorrect.
questions.explanationHi: छत्तीसगढ़ को 1 नवंबर 2000 को मध्य प्रदेश से अलग करके राज्य बनाया गया; इसे राज्योत्सव के रूप में मनाया जाता है और इसकी राजधानी रायपुर है। अन्य तिथियाँ सही नहीं हैं।

questions.question: The Revolt of 1857 began at which place?
questions.questionHi: 1857 का विद्रोह किस स्थान से प्रारंभ हुआ?
questions.explanation: The revolt began on 10 May 1857 at Meerut, when sepoys rose against their officers and marched to Delhi. Delhi, Kanpur and Jhansi became important centres later.
questions.explanationHi: विद्रोह 10 मई 1857 को मेरठ से शुरू हुआ, जब सिपाहियों ने अपने अफ़सरों के विरुद्ध विद्रोह किया और दिल्ली की ओर बढ़े। दिल्ली, कानपुर और झाँसी बाद में प्रमुख केंद्र बने।

questions.question: Which gas is the most abundant in the Earth's atmosphere?
questions.questionHi: पृथ्वी के वायुमंडल में सबसे अधिक मात्रा में कौन-सी गैस पाई जाती है?
questions.explanation: Nitrogen makes up about 78% of the air. Oxygen is about 21%, argon about 0.9%, and carbon dioxide only a tiny fraction.
questions.explanationHi: वायु में लगभग 78% नाइट्रोजन है। ऑक्सीजन लगभग 21%, आर्गन लगभग 0.9% और कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड बहुत थोड़ी मात्रा में है।

questions.question: Which is the largest Indian state by area?
questions.questionHi: क्षेत्रफल की दृष्टि से भारत का सबसे बड़ा राज्य कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: Rajasthan is the largest state by area. Madhya Pradesh is second, Maharashtra third; Uttar Pradesh is the most populous, but not the largest by area.
questions.explanationHi: क्षेत्रफल में राजस्थान सबसे बड़ा राज्य है। मध्य प्रदेश दूसरे और महाराष्ट्र तीसरे स्थान पर है; उत्तर प्रदेश सर्वाधिक जनसंख्या वाला राज्य है, क्षेत्रफल में सबसे बड़ा नहीं।
